description:
## Problem
The site re-implements parts of the rule (explorer/src/lib/subscale.ts, utils.ts, displayEligibility.ts, measurementBasis.ts, starterQueries.ts, duckdbQueries.ts, QueryHeatmap, BenchmarkIndex, RunReceipt, website/src/lib/result-receipts.ts) and embedded results show no class label (T3, T5).

## Change (benchbox-site)
- Render class, lane, score and labels from the read model; delete the derivations.
- Labels on every surface that shows a score, including benchbox-result embeds, receipts and the meta-leaderboard: the derived-result wording plus the class in plain words ("Power test only", "Throughput test only", "Subscale"), "row counts not checked", "single iteration". Derived label on TPC-H Skew, TPC-Havoc, Data Vault and TPC-DS OBT (owner decision 7).
- "Open local result" (localResult.ts) shows what the file says, marked "as recorded by the BenchBox version that wrote it, not checked" (owner decision 8).
- Show the observed engine as an attribute next to the variant label.
- Amend the site copy of the subscale ADR, the methodology page ("Only results with compliance_class=official can be submitted"), contributing-results.md, reference/cli/submit.md and data-model.md.
- Browser test asserting each label on each surface.

## Decision gates
- Label wording for TPC results must contain the sentence the owner accepted on 2026-11-17 (methodology ADR answer 11). Do not shorten it on any surface that shows a score; if a surface has no room, stop and report.

## Guardrails (apply to every item of this plan)
- Fix the root cause for every platform and benchmark. No rule, exception, label or test may name a platform or a version matrix. Only the pvm-p* items may name Polars, and only to run and stage that run's files.
- Never edit a stored result file to make it pass. Outcomes change only through the rule.
- Any change to the outcome of a stored result must show in the committed outcome snapshot diff in the same pull request and be explained in its body.
- No new stored class value. No reader may decide anything from benchmark.compliance_class, conformance_class or summary.tpc_metrics.suppressed.
- Paths, line numbers and counts in this plan were read on 2026-11-22 at develop 93f3360. Re-read before editing; report drift, do not guess.
- AGENTS.md applies: linked worktree, one pull request per item, close at the merged pull request, heavy work only through make heavy-run, no live cloud run without owner approval in that task.
- At a decision gate, follow the recorded default. If its stop condition is met, stop and report to the owner. Never substitute a different owner decision.
- Read crr-00-corpus-rule-remediation-plan first: it holds the owner decisions, the rule table and the fault types (T1 to T5).
